comments.overrides: Dev-only advisory fixes for transitive deps that browser-sync 3.0.4 still pins to old lines. All are same-major patch bumps. The version selectors on the keys keep these scoped to the stale copies -- gulp 5 ships its own newer picomatch/brace-expansion that must not be downgraded.
comments.immutable: NOT overridden on purpose. browser-sync pins immutable ^3, and the advisory (GHSA, DoS) is only cleared by 4.3.9+. Forcing ^4 breaks browser-sync at startup -- 'TypeError: server.get is not a function' -- because Immutable 4 changed the fromJS() reviver signature, so browser-sync's options tree comes back as Seqs instead of Maps. Left as a known, accepted dev-only advisory until browser-sync migrates upstream.
